item.title: [Lanka Leader] Loss of critical-thinking among new generation, says Vipula Karunatilake
item.description: Noting a steady loss of critical-thinking among the new generation due to the development and ease of use of digital technology, sociopolitical critic Vipula Karunatilake has reiterated the need for a lasting scientifically-based national policy that does not target elections or change with governments.
